newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Easyknit proposes bonus issue of shares.
newsitem.headline: Easyknit proposes bonus issue of shares.

text.p: Clothing exporter Easyknit International Holdings Ltd said it proposed a bonus share issue on the basis of two bonus shares for every share held.
"The directors of the company believe that the bonus issue will enhance the liquidity of the shares in the market," company president Koon Wing Yee said in a statement.

Easyknit said the bonus issue was conditional upon stock exchange approval and shareholder approval at a special general meeting to be on Feburary 5. The register of members will be closed from January 31 to February 5.
The subscription price of the existing 1997 warrants will be adjusted to HK$0.36 per share from HK$1.08 upon the bonus issue becoming effective, it said.
Easyknit shares ended HK$0.225 up at HK$2.90 each on Monday.
